facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Palace Theatre.
facts.excerpt: A landmark of luxury, steps from the Palace Theatre, our hotel is surrounded by vibrant eateries, quirky cocktail bars, galleries, museums, and music venues.

facts.text: The hotel has a grand Victorian facade.
facts.excerpt: Feel the historic charm of Manchester at Kimpton Clocktower Hotel, with its grand Victorian facade.

facts.text: The Refuge Bar & Restaurant serves small and large plates blending British ingredients with global influences.
facts.excerpt: Blending British ingredients with global influences to create an eclectic menu, The Refuge Bar & Restaurant features small and large plates, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

facts.text: The Refuge Public Bar makes cocktails with house-made vermouths and bespoke infusions.
facts.excerpt: Our mixologists blend classic craftsmanship with inventive flair – from house-made vermouths and bespoke infusions to bold flavour pairings you won’t find anywhere else.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in the hotel's Winter Garden, in partnership with Tea from the Manor.
facts.excerpt: Available every Friday and Saturday from 12 - 3:30pm in our stunning Winter Garden, guests can expect all the afternoon classics you know and love

facts.text: The Terrace is a courtyard with greenery, outdoor heaters and a canopy.
facts.excerpt: A unique courtyard space bursting with lush greenery and twinkling lights, The Terrace is the perfect place for a quick drink or a bite to eat al fresco.

facts.text: Suite No.51 has its own private entrance and a dedicated hotel ambassador.
facts.excerpt: Those staying at No.51 will enjoy a true VIP experience, with a dedicated Kimpton Clocktower ambassador available at the click of a button and their own private entrance.

facts.text: Suite No.51 has a record player with its own private record collection.
facts.excerpt: a Project T1 Record Player with its own private record collection

facts.text: The Duplex King Suite spans two floors, with the bedroom upstairs designed as a blackout sanctuary.
facts.excerpt: The Duplex King Suite is a unique two-floor retreat featuring a king bed, separate living space, and a spacious bathroom with separate bath and shower.

facts.text: Premium rooms include a Nespresso coffee pod machine and complimentary turndown service.
facts.excerpt: All premium rooms also include a Nespresso coffee pod machine and complimentary turndown service.

facts.text: Pets are welcome at no extra charge, regardless of size or breed.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to bring your furry, feathery or scaly family member — no matter their size, weight, or breed — at no extra charge.

facts.text: The fitness centre has cardio machines, free weights and a Peloton bike.
facts.excerpt: offering a range of equipment from cardio machines and free weights to a Peloton bike

facts.text: Free bicycles for hire are among the complimentary extras.
facts.excerpt: Free Bicycles For Hire

facts.text: The hotel runs a Social Hour with complimentary drinks for guests.
facts.excerpt: Join us for Kimpton's signature Social Hour, where guests gather to enjoy complimentary drinks and connect with fellow travellers.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Music Concierge service for guests.
facts.excerpt: you can now set the tone for your stay with a new tailor-made Music Concierge service, exclusive for guests at Kimpton Clocktower Hotel.

facts.text: The Gallery at the hotel showcases contemporary works from local and international artists.
facts.excerpt: Explore The Gallery at Kimpton Clocktower Hotel, showcasing contemporary works from local and international artists.

facts.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
facts.excerpt: No, Kimpton Clocktower Hotel does not have a pool.

facts.text: The hotel has no parking on-site; parking is available nearby from 20 pounds per day.
facts.excerpt: While we don't have parking on-site, there is plenty of parking available nearby from £20 per day.

facts.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.

facts.text: Oxford Road Train Station and Deansgate Tram Station are listed as public transportation.
facts.excerpt: Oxford Road Train Station

facts.text: The Northern Quarter is a leisurely stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A leisurely stroll from our hotel, this buzzing neighbourhood is perfect for a day of exploring.
